title: Based Extensions And Simple Elements
body_html:
Based Extensions And Simple Elements

A based extension of $F$ is a pair

$$ (E,\beta) $$

where $E=F[\beta]$ is a finite field extension of $F$ inside a fixed algebraic closure, and $\beta$ is a distinguished generator.

The draft uses an invariant

$$ k_F(\beta)\in\mathbb{Q}\sqcup\{\infty\} $$

with

$$ \operatorname{val}_F(\beta)\leq k_F(\beta), $$

with equality precisely when $\beta=0$ or $\beta$ is minimal. A based extension $(E,\beta)$ is called simple if

$$ k_F(\beta)<0. $$

In that case $\beta$ is called a simple element.

Draft Caution

The current TeX explicitly says it does not recall the definition of $k_F(\beta)$, and it leaves a TODO about the normalization of $\operatorname{val}_F$.
